data.name: DRFT
data.detailed_description:
DRFT is a physics-based arena shooter. Weaponize the raw momentum of every drift to supercharge into an invulnerable wrecking ball. Shred waves of foes and bounce off walls to survive. Between runs, stack upgrades to turn your hard-to-handle hatchback into a screen-clearing machine of destruction.

THE LOOP

  • FRICTION IS FUEL: Your tires are your power source. Drift to push your hatchback into overdrive.

  • BECOME THE WRECKING BALL: Reach max charge to go invulnerable. Weaponize your chassis and flatten every foe in your path.

  • BOUNCE TO SURVIVE: Every drift and wall-bounce is a chance to escape. Master your hatchback's erratic physics to turn a dead end into a getaway.

THE HATCHBACK

Don't let the size fool you. Customize your ride with over-the-top upgrades:

  • STACK YOUR ARSENAL: From rapid-fire machineguns to razor sharp caltrops.

  • ELEMENTAL OVERDRIVE: Customize your build by infusing your weapons with specialized affinities—shattering foes with Rime, electrocuting enemies with Conduit, or unleashing pure Chaos.

  • FROM SCRAP TO SUPREME: Stack enough power to transform your tiny car into a screen-clearing engine of destruction.

FEATURES

  • MOMENTUM IS EVERYTHING: Weaponize your velocity to pulverize your foes, but stay sharp—in this arena, your greatest asset can quickly become your fatal flaw.

  • QUICK-FIRE CHAOS: High-intensity, bite-sized sessions that cut the fluff and get straight to the drift—built for that "just one more lap" itch.

  • ENDLESS SYNERGIES: No two runs are the same. Experiment with five elemental affinities and wild upgrade combos to discover your own game-breaking build.
